name: JAKS Resources Berhad
overview: 今年公司主要推进出售全资间接子公司 JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal Sdn Bhd 100% 股权，交易对价 RM15.00 million 并涉及买方结清 JSNT 欠 JAKS 最多 RM40.00 million 的款项，完成期限多次延长至 2027 年 3 月 31 日；同时 JAKS Solar Power Holdings 与 CPECC Int'l 的 MOU 年内无进一步实质进展。此外公司进行多轮集资活动，但公告未披露具体业务板块用途。
overview_en: The main corporate action this year is the proposed disposal of 100% equity interest in indirect wholly-owned subsidiary JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal Sdn Bhd for RM15.00 million cash, with the purchaser to settle up to RM40.00 million owed by JSNT to JAKS; the completion deadline has been extended several times to 31 March 2027. Meanwhile, the MOU between JAKS Solar Power Holdings and CPECC Int'l saw no further material development during the year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 推进出售 JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal 全部股权，并披露与 CPECC Int'l 的 MOU 无进一步实质进展。
segments.note_en: Progressing the disposal of the entire equity interest in JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal and disclosed no further material development on the MOU with CPECC Int'l.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述出售事项的先决条件满足期限再延长 175 天，从 2026 年 10 月 7 日延至 2027 年 3 月 31 日。
actions.text_en: The period for fulfilment of conditions precedent for the disposal was further extended by 175 days from 7 October 2026 to 31 March 2027.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 上述出售事项的先决条件满足期限延长 90 天至 2026 年 10 月 7 日，完成日期相应延长。
actions.text_en: The period for fulfilment of conditions precedent for the disposal was extended by 90 days to 7 October 2026, with the completion date correspondingly extended.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: JAKS Solar Power Holdings Sdn Bhd 与 China Power Engineering Consulting Group International Engineering Co., Ltd. 的 MOU 截至公告日无进一步实质进展。
actions.text_en: There was no further material development pertaining to the MOU between JAKS Solar Power Holdings Sdn Bhd and China Power Engineering Consulting Group International Engineering Co., Ltd. as of the announcement date.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司拟出售 JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal Sdn Bhd 全部股权，退出该太阳能相关子公司。
model_changes.text_en: The company proposed to dispose of its entire equity interest in JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal Sdn Bhd, exiting the solar-related subsidiary.
